_README: Target cases come from probe v9 exact certificates, the v2 phrase-enrichment
screen, the Neuroscope spot check, and probe v11's factorial panel.
N541 peaks on the FINAL token of the certificate (80/80 routes in v9), which
is what makes peak position sharply defined and therefore gradeable.
t08, t10, t11, t12 are v11 strings with MEASURED peaks and signed margins
recorded in each note. They serve two purposes: they are the only cases where
N541 fires but does NOT win layer 5 (so they test the destination path
independently of N541's own trace), and their recorded values let you check
this exporter against your existing v11 results before Forge is involved.
Control, structural and bos_pair cases probe alignment, tokenizer and BOS
handling. s03 is an accidental N541 hit (peaks on ' time' completing
'one at a time') and is kept deliberately.

cases.note: long window; accumulates numerical divergence
cases.text: In the beginning the model reads one token at a time, and each layer adds its own small contribution to the residual stream. The attention heads move information between positions, while the multi-layer perceptron transforms information within a position. Over many layers these two operations compose into behaviour that is difficult to predict from either one alone. This paragraph exists only to produce a long enough window that any accumulating numerical divergence between two implementations has room to become visible before the sequence ends, so it continues past the point where it has anything new to say, deliberately and at some length, until the token count is comfortably large.
